Energy_Bar_X: POSITION X-AXIS (ENERGY BAR)            -  Enter a positive value in increments at +2 to move the bar to the right. Enter a negative value ´to move the bar to the left
Energy_Bar_Y: POSITION Y-AXIS (ENERGY BAR)            -  Enter a positive value in increments at +2 to move the bar down. Enter a negative value ´to move the bar upwards
Sleepiness_Bar_X: POSITION X-AXIS (SLEEPINESS BAR)        -  Enter a positive value in increments at +2 to move the bar to the right. Enter a negative value ´to move the bar to the left
Sleepiness_Bar_Y: POSITION Y-AXIS (SLEEPINESS BAR)        -  Enter a positive value in increments at +2 to move the bar to the right. Enter a negative value ´to move the bar to the left
Energy_Bar_Fill_Direction_Right_To_Left: FILL DIRECTION (ENERGY BAR)             -  False = Bar will fill the opposite direction of (Right To Left) right side of the bar towards the left side.
Sleepiness_Bar_Fill_Direction_Right_To_L: FILL DIRECTION (SLEEPINESS BAR)         -  true = Bar will fill from right side of the bar towards the left side.
Sleepiness_Bar_Visible: HIDE SLEEPINESS BAR                     -  Should the Sleepiness bar be vissible?
Hide_Sleepiness_Bar_At: HIDE VALUE                              -  If sleepiness is below set value, then the bar hides. (If set to 3, the bar will hide when sleepiness is below 3. Default is 0 so it never hides.)
Energy_Bar_Color: COLOR                                   -  Change the color of the HUD bars, by entering a new Hexidecimal ¨HEX¨ value of a color you'd like. Google it when in doubt how to, and it dosn't matter if it's upper or lower case letters in the config file.
